text:
Mia: Heads up — seeing ~30% invoice delta for a cohort of tenants over last 60m, dashboard spikes.
Sam: Which pipeline? streaming or batch?
Mia: streaming. spikes then decay, looks like duplicate post-agg lines.
Arjun: We flipped the continuous batching window last night 30s -> 5m to save GPU cycles. Could be the culprit.
Lina: Larger window changes watermark behaviour. late arrivals might be landing in separate committed buckets.
Mia: How does that become duplicated invoice lines? Need repro steps for finance.
Arjun: Short: event -> fingerprint -> pre-agg (window) -> aggregator writes minute buckets. If event arrives after commit (older watermark) some shards emit a new event instead of reconciling, so same tokens counted twice.
Sam: So stretching window increases chance of falling between commit and dedupe boundaries; retries/replays show up later.
Mia: Customers are billed twice until downstream dedupe/backfill runs. Not acceptable.
Lina: Quick metric to add: ingest.duplicate_rate_by_arrival_delay (histogram) and per-tenant tail. Also add dashboard panel correlating invoice_delta with arrival_delay > 120s.
Arjun: Proposed immediate actions: revert window to 60s (middle-ground) + add a shadow idempotency dedupe at aggregator keyed by (fingerprint, canonical_minute). Index change for full fix later.
Sam: Index change is heavy. Alternative: deploy shadow dedupe (read-only) that emits delta metrics so we can validate before touching writes.
OpsBot: Created feature flag feature.ingest.small_window (status: disabled) :gear: 
OpsBot: Created feature flag feature.ingest.shadow_dedupe (status: disabled) :gear:
Mia: Shadow mode sounds safe. We need concrete rollout and finance projection of potential credits.
Lina: I'll run a shadow SQL compare. Draft:
```
SELECT tenant_id, count(*) FILTER (WHERE shadow_count>0) as dup_events, avg(arrival_delay) as avg_delay
FROM shadow_metrics
WHERE event_time >= now() - interval '2 hours'
GROUP BY tenant_id
ORDER BY dup_events DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
Arjun: Implementation tasks: 1) add non-blocking shadow dedupe path + metrics 2) small-window toggle 3) metric instrumentation 4) canary runner. ETA 6-8h dev + infra review.
Sam: Rollout plan I propose: enable shadow globally for 1h to gather data; canary small_window at 2% traffic (tenant-sampled) with shadow on; monitor duplicate_rate and invoice_delta. Expand to 10% then to 100% with auto-rollback if dup_rate > 5x baseline.
Mia: Finance wants a list of tenants with dup_rate > 0.5% in shadow run and estimated credit amounts for outreach.
Lina: I'll produce per-tenant credit projection after shadow completes and share in #finance.
Sam: I'll own the playbook + auto-rollback rule and add trace_id propagation so we can correlate duplicates end-to-end.
Mia: Please notify #support and #finance before canary. Prepare a canned message and temporary dashboard widget for any affected tenants. :thumbsup:
BillingService: Started backfill-run id=bf-20260320-01 for tenants flagged by previous audit (informational).
Support: Will prepare the canned FAQ and Slack template; ping us when canary starts.
Sam: Shadow run scheduled in next deploy (in ~30m). Canary for small_window scheduled in 3h if metrics look ok.
Arjun: If small-window doesn't mitigate fully, we'll implement the idempotency index as the durable fix.
Mia: Thanks — prioritize transparency. Ping #support and #finance at canary start and include per-tenant summary.
